fingerprinted_terminal_input_manifest.binding: The frozen provenance snapshot supplies the individual logical paths, SHA-256 values and byte sizes. The builder verifies all 58 before source-only projection.

tracked_model_facing_structured_inputs.definition: The complete Git-tracked structured outbound-input corpus frozen by the committed context-evidence pilot at this repository state. RAW stdout, stderr, candidate and reasoning artifacts are excluded by contract.

phase0.base_frame: Reconstruct all 1,396 task/revision rows directly from canonical membership and the provenance snapshot's fingerprinted terminal contextual inputs. Match only task_id plus original_revision_key/revision_key and verify only source_sha256.
phase0.access_control: Every canonical membership and terminal translation_snapshot item is wrapped in a fail-closed Proxy. Reconstruction reads only the eight permitted source fields and recomputes all seven source-only flags; it never reads upstream mixed risk flags, canonical identities, pair hashes, terminology snapshots or translation-side values.
phase0.invariance_gate: Changing or deleting all translation-side fields in upstream terminal items and canonical membership must leave the base frame, screen counts, seeded ranks, selection and final presentation canonical-byte-identical. This is exercised from reconstructSourceOnlyBaseRows by test-builder.mjs.
phase0.term_name_policy: Rows whose profile is term-name are ineligible before classification and cannot appear in either category. No terminology records or terminology-derived flags are read.

exposure_registry.normalization: Collapse actual whitespace and literal Lua escaped newline, carriage-return and tab sequences to one ASCII space; remove leading and trailing whitespace.
exposure_registry.exclusion: A candidate is excluded when either key is present in a frozen structured model-facing input.

Runtime.predicate: At least one of the seven source-only flags is present.

Narrative.predicate: At least four of the seven source-only flags are present, or the frozen English pronoun/demonstrative regular expression matches.

order: reconstruct the 1,396-row source-only base from canonical membership and fingerprinted terminal inputs
bind the registered source artifact and locate the complete normalized source
accept exactly one or two occurrences
sample by seeded task-first round robin
locator_and_selection.duplicate_representative: Lexicographically first task_id, then original_revision_key, then section.
locator_and_selection.task_order: sha256(seed + NUL + category + NUL + task + NUL + task_id), then task_id.
locator_and_selection.within_task_order: sha256(seed + NUL + category + NUL + row + NUL + task_id + NUL + original_revision_key), then original_revision_key.
locator_and_selection.round_robin: Visit every task once per round and select at most one row from that task in that round.

source_evidence_packet.match: Complete whitespace-normalized literal source match; accept one or two occurrences only.
source_evidence_packet.matched_span_policy: Replace the matched span with the marker. Never concatenate, compare or otherwise bind a translation target.
source_evidence_packet.utf8_policy: All byte caps trim only on Unicode code-point boundaries.
